mapper.sql: exists(select 1 from biz_company_access ca join sys_user ca_user on ca_user.user_id=ca.user_id and ca_user.status='0' and ca_user.del_flag='0' join sys_dept ca_company on ca_company.dept_id=ca.company_dept_id and ca_company.status='0' and ca_company.del_flag='0' where ca.company_dept_id=${company} and ca.user_id=#{userId} and find_in_set('${capability}',ca.capabilities) and exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ca_ur join sys_role ca_r on ca_r.role_id=ca_ur.role_id where ca_ur.user_id=ca.user_id and ca_r.role_key='company_owner' and ca_r.status='0' and ca_r.del_flag='0'))
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_company_access ca join sys_user u on u.user_id=ca.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=ca.company_dept_id and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' where ca.user_id=#{userId} and ca.company_dept_id=#{companyId} and find_in_set(#{capability},ca.capabilities) and exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=ca.user_id and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0')

select c.dept_id from sys_dept d join sys_dept c on (c.dept_id=d.dept_id or find_in_set(c.dept_id,d.ancestors)) and c.parent_id=100 where d.dept_id=#{deptId} and d.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' limit 1

select c.dept_id from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id join sys_dept c on (c.dept_id=d.dept_id or find_in_set(c.dept_id,d.ancestors)) and c.parent_id=100 where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' limit 1
select company_dept_id from biz_project where project_id=#{projectId} and del_flag='0'

select d.dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,coalesce(ca.capabilities,'') capabilities from sys_dept d left join biz_company_access ca on ca.company_dept_id=d.dept_id and ca.user_id=#{userId} where d.parent_id=100 and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' and order by d.order_num,d.dept_id

select ca.user_id,u.nick_name user_name,ca.capabilities,ca.version,ca.update_by,ca.update_time from biz_company_access ca join sys_user u on u.user_id=ca.user_id where ca.company_dept_id=#{companyId} order by ca.user_id

select distinct u.user_id userId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'

select count(*) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'
select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyId} and parent_id=100 and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
select coalesce((select version from biz_company_access where company_dept_id=#{companyId} and user_id=#{userId}),0)
mapper.insert: insert into biz_company_access(company_dept_id,user_id,capabilities,version,update_by) values(#{companyId},#{userId},#{capabilities},1,#{actorName}) on duplicate key update capabilities=values(capabilities),version=version+1,update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()
